discordPostHtml:
Supernova

Supernova is a mod that adds ships, weapons a factions and other such goodies for you all to enjoy.

Trade and interact with the Nova Industries, a friendly corporation that uses fast ships with strong shields but extremely weak armor and hull.

Fight against many tiny versions of your beloved ships, from the Astral and Onslaught to the [REDACTED]

Fight against interesting bounties, from greedy fuel traders to secret projects

I hope you have fun! This is my very first mod, so don't expect the highest of quality. Still, I'll work to improve the mod as much as i can!

changelog.0.6.4:
- Added a "I" to the smallest Novan cargo ship's name.
- Added a pirate version of the Cycle I and a weapon to go with it.
- Added small and medium cargo ships to the Nova Industries
- Buffed the Framework bounty ship
- Fixed the Novan weapon and fighter tags, now they actually use their weapons
- Nerfed all of the Nova Industries' shields ability to ake damage, however made most of the combat ships have 360 degree shields
- Changed wether some weapons can or can't be seen in the codex
- Added the Atom support drone to the Nova Industries
- Added the Nevershield PD, the Storm's Eye MIRV, the Twilight Heavy Cannon and the Morningstar weapons.
- Decreased the range and increased the damage of the Comet's built-in
- Increased the damage of the Dawn and Dusk weapons
- More tips
- Made the Lagrange act more like a carrier
- Again updated a bunch of the names of the Nova Industries' ranks
- Sorted and added to the NOVA selection of ship names
- Updated the flag and crest of the Nova Industries and its blueprint icons to go with it
- Added the Dragon Division and the Shadow Fleet subfactions for the Nova Industries
- Added the Thumb, Stake and Eyelid frigates to the tritach
- awawa
- Moved all of the ship designations of the Nova Industries from the names to the descriptions for better readability
- Fixed the cover colors of the Cycle I, II and III
- Increased the OP cost for the Low Intensity Laser
- Made several of the tiny ships a rarer sight
- Slightly buffed Dawn's range
